entry.ptxt: Symptom
Inspection Point
Reference Page
The message "Please check the telephone" is displayed from the first connection
It is highly likely that the cellular phone being used is not G-BOOK compatible, so have the customer check it (compatible models can be checked at G-BOOK.com on the Internet)
"Please check the telephone" is displayed
Refer to troubleshooting flowchart ["Please check the telephone" continues to be displayed]
"Telephone is not connected" is displayed
Refer to troubleshooting flowchart ["Please check the telephone" continues to be displayed]
The message "Please wait" appears and it temporarily takes a long time until the screen is displayed
This is due to radio wave conditions or base station congestion and is not a malfunction (explain to the customer and have them continue using it)
"Line is busy. Please wait a while before use" is displayed
The carrier is restricting outgoing calls from the telephone, so explain to the customer that they should wait a while before using it
The message "Cannot display because the line is busy, etc. Please wait a while before operating" is temporarily displayed
This is due to radio wave conditions or base station congestion and is not a malfunction (explain to the customer and have them continue using it)
"Cannot display because the line is busy, etc. Please wait a while before operating" continues to be displayed
Refer to troubleshooting flowchart [Cellular Phone Communication Malfunction]
"Could not acquire information because the line is busy, etc." is displayed
Wait a while, change location and operate again
Refer to troubleshooting flowchart [Cellular Phone Communication Malfunction]
"Initial communication setting is required. It can be set from G-BOOK.com on the main menu" is displayed
Explain to the customer that the G-BOOK online service registration procedure is required, and have them make a G-BOOK service contract according to the owner's manual
"Out of communication range. Please move into communication range before use" is displayed
Wait a while, change location and operate again (move into communication range)
Refer to troubleshooting flowchart [Cellular Phone Communication Malfunction]
"Communication is locked. Please release the lock before use" is displayed
Explain to the customer that the communication lock must be released to use G-BOOK
If the customer has forgotten how to release the communication lock (PIN), check according to the owner's manual
If the customer has also forgotten the reminder (answer to the question), check with the G-BOOK Support Center
"Cannot be used because time data is old. Please receive GPS" is displayed
Refer to HDD Navigation System - Problem Symptoms Table [GPS mark is not displayed]
If the GPS mark is displayed, wait a while, change location and operate again; if the malfunction occurs, replace the navigation receiver assembly
"This service cannot be used because the microphone is not connected" is displayed
Refer to HDD Navigation System - Problem Symptoms Table [Voice recognition does not work (no "beep" when recognition switch is pressed)]
"Cannot be used due to low temperature. Please wait a while before use" is displayed
Explain to the customer that the system cannot be used at low temperatures (-20°C or less), and ask them to wait until the vehicle interior temperature rises before use
"Could not register bookmark" is displayed when registering a bookmark
Explain to the customer that the system cannot be used at low temperatures (-20°C or less), and ask them to wait until the vehicle interior temperature rises before use
Navigation Check - HDD Information
"Could not delete" is displayed when deleting a bookmark
Explain to the customer that the system cannot be used at low temperatures (-20°C or less), and ask them to wait until the vehicle interior temperature rises before use
Navigation Check - HDD Information
"Could not update" is displayed when editing a bookmark
Explain to the customer that the system cannot be used at low temperatures (-20°C or less), and ask them to wait until the vehicle interior temperature rises before use
Navigation Check - HDD Information
"Could not register" is displayed when registering a word for character conversion
Explain to the customer that the system cannot be used at low temperatures (-20°C or less), and ask them to wait until the vehicle interior temperature rises before use
Navigation Check - HDD Information
"Could not edit" is displayed when editing a fixed phrase
Explain to the customer that the system cannot be used at low temperatures (-20°C or less), and ask them to wait until the vehicle interior temperature rises before use
Navigation Check - HDD Information
"Could not delete" is displayed when deleting input history
Explain to the customer that the system cannot be used at low temperatures (-20°C or less), and ask them to wait until the vehicle interior temperature rises before use
Navigation Check - HDD Information

Inspection Point
Reference Page
G-BOOK read-aloud voice is not output
G-BOOK read-aloud volume is not linked to other audio volume adjustments, so adjust the volume according to the owner's manual

Inspection Point
Reference Page
"Cannot play because of unsupported format" is displayed when playing a karaoke song
It is highly likely that there is a content problem, so contact the G-BOOK Support Center
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
"Cannot play because of unsupported format" is displayed when acquiring a BGM channel
It is highly likely that there is a content problem, so contact the G-BOOK Support Center
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
"Cannot play because of unsupported format" is displayed when playing a BGM channel
It is highly likely that there is a content problem, so contact the G-BOOK Support Center
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly

It is highly likely that there is a content problem, so contact the G-BOOK Support Center
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
"Cannot change channel because of unsupported format. Please select another channel guide..." is displayed when changing channel guides

"G-Library disc is required. Please check the disc" is displayed when the G Library copy switch is pressed
Check that the inserted disc is a G-Library disc
If the disc is dirty, clean the disc and operate again
If the disc is scratched, replace the disc and operate again
If the symptom recurs, it is highly likely that there is a content problem, so contact the G-BOOK Support Center
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
"Could not copy" is displayed when the G Library copy switch is pressed
If the disc is dirty, clean the disc and operate again
If the disc is scratched, replace the disc and operate again
If the symptom recurs, it is highly likely that there is a content problem, so contact the G-BOOK Support Center
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
"No corresponding content found" is displayed no matter which content is selected on the G Library copy top screen
If the disc is dirty, clean the disc and operate again
If the disc is scratched, replace the disc and operate again
If the symptom recurs, it is highly likely that there is a content problem, so contact the G-BOOK Support Center
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
Symptom
Inspection Point
Reference Page
"Could not acquire song data because contract information has been changed" is displayed when playing a song

If the symptom recurs in a location with good radio wave conditions, it is highly likely that the AUTOLIVE contract information has not been updated, so press the "Update Course List" switch in the AUTOLIVE karaoke course list
If the symptom is not resolved, contact the G-BOOK Support Center
"Could not acquire song data. Please wait a while and operate again" is displayed when playing a song

If the symptom recurs in a location with good radio wave conditions, it is highly likely that the AUTOLIVE contract information has not been updated, so press the "Update Course List" switch in the AUTOLIVE karaoke course list
If the symptom is not resolved, contact the G-BOOK Support Center

If the symptom recurs in a location with good radio wave conditions, it is highly likely that the AUTOLIVE contract information has not been updated, so press the "Update Course List" switch in the AUTOLIVE karaoke course list

If the symptom recurs in a location with good radio wave conditions, it is highly likely that the AUTOLIVE contract information has not been updated, so press the "Update Course List" switch in the AUTOLIVE karaoke course list

Symptom
Inspection Point
Reference Page
The manual maintenance check button is not displayed on the settings screen
Make a G-BOOK contract
Perform the G-BOOK use resumption operation
The manual maintenance check button is no longer displayed on the settings screen
Check whether the G-BOOK contract has expired
The HELPNET button is not displayed on the information screen
Perform the service start operation (manual maintenance check) again
Refer to troubleshooting flowchart [Cellular Phone Communication Malfunction]
